summary: This bill directs the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to posthumously award a Congressional Gold Medal to former President Jimmy Carter in recognition of his service to the Nation, with the medal to be given to the Carter Center.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes the striking of a Congressional Gold Medal and duplicate bronze medals, with costs to be charged against the United States Mint Public Enterprise Fund. This represents a minor increase in government spending for the production of these medals.
